chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Al-Hakam ibn Ayman, from Aban ibn Taghlib, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Whoever performs Tawaf of the House (Kaaba) for seven circuits, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will write for him six thousand good deeds, erase from him six thousand sins, and elevate him by six thousand degrees.'
He said: And Is'hak ibn 'Ammar added to it: 'And He will fulfill for him six thousand needs.'
He said: Then he said: 'And fulfilling the need of a believer is superior to performing Tawaf and Tawaf,' until he counted ten.
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual rewards of performing seven circuits of Tawaf and fulfilling a believer's need?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to illustrate the hierarchy of worship, contrasting the ritualistic merit of Tawaf with the social virtue of serving the community. The addition by Isma'il ibn Hammad regarding the cancellation of debts and fulfillment of needs underscores the Shia emphasis on 'qada' al-hajat' (meeting the needs of others) as a superior act of devotion that bridges the gap between individual piety and communal solidarity.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, form Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Hakam Bin Ayman, from Aban Bin Taghlub who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘The one performs Tawaaf of the House (Kabah) by seven (circuits), Allahazwj would Write for him six thousand good deeds, and Delete from him six thousand sins, and Elevate for him six thousand levels’.
And Is’haq Bin Ammar (another narrator) has an increase in it, ‘(He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said): ‘And Fulfill for him six thousand needs’.
Heasws said: ‘And the fulfilling of a need of a Momin is superior than performing a Tawaaf, and a Tawaaf’ – until heasws had numbered ten’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from al- Hakam ibn Ayman from Aban ibn Taghlib who has said the following:

“I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘One who performs Tawaf (walking seven times around the Ka’ba for worship) Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, will write for him six thousand good deeds, delete his six thousand sins, and will raise him six thousand degrees in meritorious status.’
The narrator has said that Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar has added, ‘His six thousand wishes will be made to come true’.

“The narrator has said that The Imam said, ‘To help the wish of a believer come true is better then a Tawaf, and Tawaf. . . . (walking seven times around the Ka’ba for worship), repeating it ten times.’”
